Note:

[Story]
Zhao Yang pretends to be a foreign tourist in the supermarket, and says he does not understand Chinese, using exaggerated body language and a stiff foreign language to ask employees and customers for product information. Zhao Yang's behavior attracts the attention of many customers, they are amused by his body language, some even try to help him.

[Question]
Why did Li Hua do this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Because Li Hua wanted to work together with his crush, Xiao Qian, to organize desks and chairs.
B. Because Li Hua wanted to avoid doing tasks like sweeping and window cleaning.
C. Because Li Hua caught a cold and was very weak, unable to handle heavy work.
D. Because Li Hua excels in academics and helps classmates, and this time he hoped his classmates would help him.
